+++ b/src/click/reverse_source_priority.py
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .core import _check_nested_chain
+from .core import Command
+from .core import CommandCollection
+from .core import Context
+
+
+class ReverseSourcePriority(CommandCollection):
+    """A collection that checks its own commands, then sources from last to first."""
+
+    def get_command(self, ctx: Context, cmd_name: str) -> Command | None:
+        rv = super(CommandCollection, self).get_command(ctx, cmd_name)
+
+        if rv is not None:
+            return rv
+
+        for source in reversed(self.sources):
+            rv = source.get_command(ctx, cmd_name)
+
+            if rv is not None:
+                if self.chain:
+                    _check_nested_chain(self, cmd_name, rv)
+
+                return rv
+
+        return None
notes:
The override anchors super() at CommandCollection to preserve its direct lookup and MRO, then searches sources in reverse without modifying the list. Chain validation and miss handling are unchanged, and no existing modules were edited.
